message.content:
Step 1: Calculate the total number of notebooks sold during the week.
60 (Monday) + 10 (Tuesday) + 20 (Wednesday) + 44 (Thursday) + 66 (Friday) = 200 notebooks sold.

Step 2: Subtract the total number of notebooks sold from the initial stock of notebooks.
800 (initial stock) - 200 (notebooks sold) = 600 notebooks not sold.

Final answer: 600
message.reasoning:
The problem asks for the number of notebooks that were not sold.
Initial stock = 800 notebooks.
Sold on Monday = 60
Sold on Tuesday = 10
Sold on Wednesday = 20
Sold on Thursday = 44
Sold on Friday = 66
Total sold = 60 + 10 + 20 + 44 + 66
60 + 10 = 70
70 + 20 = 90
90 + 44 = 134
134 + 66 = 200
Total sold = 200
Not sold = Initial stock - Total sold
Not sold = 800 - 200 = 600
The question asks "How many notebooks were not sold?".
The answer is 600.
